quests.title: Luhua Landscape

dialogue.t: (This statue's head has a hole in a head, and it seems something may be inserted into it...)
(This statue's head has a hole in a head, and it seems something may be inserted into it...)
Have you found my painting tools?
Just as I thought, I left them in the place I was taking references from. I tend to put the things I've used on the ground while I paint out of habit.
When I'm in too much of a rush, I tend to leave a lot of things behind. Thank you so much. If not for you, I'd have to go back into the city to buy more.

dialogue.sit: You're going to continue painting here?

dialogue.t: Don't even mention it. I'd heard people say that these two statues have eyes that could light up, and that you could see that from afar.
Giant statues with blazing eyes, standing guard next to a mountain... It would surely have made an excellent painting.
But when I came here, the statues were here, but there were no shining eyes to be found.
I thought that I might have missed some special timing, or that my angle was off, which is why I've been walking around.
But it seems that no matter where I stand, the scenery doesn't change...
The only thing I've gotten out of the whole venture is this — I found it in the pond down there...
Did you? Let me have a look. Why, I never — they're identical.
Strange. There are even words carved into the back. Now, what do they say...
"The stone sentinels hold the gate as such, against those who add not a finishing touch..." What does this mean?
Well, this rock's of little use to me, anyway, so why don't you have it? Consider it thanks for helping me find my tools.
Actually, I have a thought. It's just a wild guess, but don't you think these two rocks look a bit like eyes?
If they really are eyes, do you think that the "finishing touch" has something to do with these two stones.
Well, it's just a guess, so don't think too hard about it. I'm going to look for other views, now — thanks for finding my tools for me!
Oh, this is terrible. How will I paint like this...?
You... Oh, it's you, Traveler. Well, here's the problem: I've been looking for inspiration around the Luhua Pool, and I wanted to paint a few pictures to bring back with me.
But I haven't been able to find a good angle, and so none of my paintings have been to my satisfaction.
I was so focused on taking the scenery in that I only realized that most of my paintbrushes and paints had gone missing when I arrived here.
I must have left them in the previous posts where I'd painted pictures. Could you help me look for them?

dialogue.sit: Where did you paint those pictures?

dialogue.t: Uh, actually... I don't quite remember myself. I was too engrossed in my painting each time to pay my surroundings much mind, so I can't give you very specific locations...
But I've only drawn two pictures in this area, so it can only be in those two places.
I'll give you these two paintings. I'm sure that I must have left my painting tools in the areas I was <color=#00E1FFFF>using as a reference</color> for those paintings.
Once you've found them, please bring them back to me. I'll keep looking around here... I'm sure there's a better angle to take.
I should bring more materials to paint with next time...
Or maybe I should keep a memo of the things I lose instead...
Have you found my painting tools?
Just as I thought, I left them in the place I was taking references from. I tend to put the things I've used on the ground while I paint out of habit.
When I'm in too much of a rush, I tend to leave a lot of things behind. Thank you so much. If not for you, I'd have to go back into the city to buy more.

dialogue.sit: You're going to continue painting here?

dialogue.t: Don't even mention it. I'd heard people say that these two statues have eyes that could light up, and that you could see that from afar.
Giant statues with blazing eyes, standing guard next to a mountain... It would surely have made an excellent painting.
But when I came here, the statues were here, but there were no shining eyes to be found.
I thought that I might have missed some special timing, or that my angle was off, which is why I've been walking around.
But it seems that no matter where I stand, the scenery doesn't change...
The only thing I've gotten out of the whole venture is this — I found it in the pond down there.
I have no clue what it is, but the more I look at it, the more it resembles an eye.
But if this is an eye, then there might be another similar rock nearby. People do have two eyes, after all...
*sigh* That's my conjecture, anyway. Don't think too hard about it. This rock's of little use to me, anyway, so why don't you have it? Consider it thanks for helping me find my tools.
Statues with shining eyes... I wonder what secrets one can uncover in Luhua Pool?
How will I find that one perfect view...
About the rock? Why are you suddenly interested in that?
I picked it up while looking for a good view at <color=#00E1FFFF>Luhua Pool</color>.
Do you want to go to <color=#00E1FFFF>Luhua Pool</color> to have a look?
You'll have to keep a close eye out. There're all sorts of things in that pool, and I have no idea who threw it in there...
(test)方碑解开了,你真厉害,我去画画了,你继续加油
(test)之后一定要来找我呀,让你看看我的得意之作
This isn't right... This can't be right. Those statues' eyes don't light up...
Is my viewfinding technique wrong somehow? No, that can't be it...
Eyes... What eyes? This statue doesn't have any at all.
Oh... So that's how it is! These two rocks really are the eyes of the two statues. Their eyes will only shine once you've slotted those stones in...
Looks like I'll be able to paint something great after all! I'm off to find a good angle! Thank you so much!
Wonderful, absolutely wonderful...

quests.description: Vermeer, an artist who is looking for inspirational material near Luhua Pool, seems to have hit a snag, and is looking for help…
